description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerScoringRequest" name="Customer scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AgencyScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Frontend" name="Credit scoring frontend" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Frontend">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesClerk" name="Sales clerk">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ClerkRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClerkRequestScoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FrontendSoftware" name="Frontend software">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FrontendWait</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FrontendImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FrontendDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FrontendDelayedResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PresentImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PresentDelayedResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FrontendImmediate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FrontendDelayed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ClerkRequest" name="Clerk initiates scoring request"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClerkRequestScoring" name="Request credit scoring through frontend"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit scoring request to banking system" messageRef="Message_CustomerScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_FrontendWait" name="Wait for banking system information" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FrontendImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FrontendImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FrontendDelay" name="Delay notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FrontendDelay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayDelay" name="Display check again later message to clerk"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FrontendDelayedResult" name="Scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FrontendDelayedResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentImmediateResult" name="Present scoring result to clerk"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentDelayedResult" name="Present scoring result to clerk"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FrontendImmediate" name="Immediate result presented"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FrontendDelayed" name="Delayed result presented"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_1" sourceRef="Start_ClerkRequest" targetRef="Task_ClerkRequestScoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_2" sourceRef="Task_ClerkRequestScoring" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_3" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Gateway_FrontendWait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_4" sourceRef="Gateway_FrontendWait" targetRef="Event_FrontendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_5" sourceRef="Gateway_FrontendWait" targetRef="Event_FrontendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_6" sourceRef="Event_FrontendImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_PresentImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_7" sourceRef="Task_PresentImmediateResult" targetRef="End_FrontendImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_8" sourceRef="Event_FrontendDelay" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_9" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelay" targetRef="Event_FrontendDelayedResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_10" sourceRef="Event_FrontendDelayedResult" targetRef="Task_PresentDelayedResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_11" sourceRef="Task_PresentDelayedResult" targetRef="End_FrontendDelayed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BankingSystem" name="Banking system credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BankingRequest" name="Customer scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankingRequest" messageRef="Message_CustomerScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAgencyRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_AgencyScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_BankingWait" name="Wait for agency response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BankingImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankingImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BankingDelay" name="Delay notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankingDelay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyFrontendDelay" name="Send delay notification to frontend" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BankingDelayedResult" name="Scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankingDelayedResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResultToFrontend" name="Send scoring result to frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayedResultToFrontend" name="Send scoring result to frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankingImmediate" name="Immediate result sent to frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankingDelayed" name="Delayed result sent to frontend"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_1" sourceRef="Start_BankingRequest" targetRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_2" sourceRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest" targetRef="Gateway_BankingWait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_3" sourceRef="Gateway_BankingWait" targetRef="Event_BankingImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_4" sourceRef="Gateway_BankingWait" targetRef="Event_BankingDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_5" sourceRef="Event_BankingImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResultToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_6" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResultToFrontend" targetRef="End_BankingImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_7" sourceRef="Event_BankingDelay" targetRef="Task_NotifyFrontendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_8" sourceRef="Task_NotifyFrontendDelay" targetRef="Event_BankingDelayedResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_9" sourceRef="Event_BankingDelayedResult" targetRef="Task_SendDelayedResultToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_10" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayedResultToFrontend" targetRef="End_BankingDelayed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_AgencyScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateResult" name="Can the result be determined immediately?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_Agency_Delayed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyImmediate" name="Immediate result sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotification" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayedResult" name="Send scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyDelayed" name="Delayed result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Immediate" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">resultIsImmediate</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Delayed" name="Result takes longer" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_AgencyImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotification" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendDelayedResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayedResult" targetRef="End_AgencyDelayed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Frontend" name="Sales clerk frontend" processRef="Process_Frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_BankingSystem"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerRequest" name="Customer scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Start_BankingRequest" messageRef="Message_CustomerScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest" targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_AgencyScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Event_BankingImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotification" targetRef="Event_BankingDelay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayedResult" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayedResult" targetRef="Event_BankingDelayedResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendDelay" name="Delay notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyFrontendDelay" targetRef="Event_FrontendDelay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResultToFrontend" targetRef="Event_FrontendImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendDelayedResult" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayedResultToFrontend" targetRef="Event_FrontendDelayedResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
